newsitem.title: USA: MGM merges home video and consumer product units.
newsitem.headline: MGM merges home video and consumer product units.

text.p: Metro-Goldwyn Mayer Inc film studio on Wednesday said it is combining the operations of its home entertainment and consumer products divisions into a single operating unit.
"We believe consumer products are one of MGM's key growth areas," Vice Chairman Robert Pisano said in a statement.
The new group will share financial, business and legal functions, and will be headed by Richard Cohen who has been president of the home entertainment division since 1994.
Cohen also has overseen consumer products since last year.

MGM is owned by a partnership between investor Kirk Kerkorian's Tracinda Corp and Australian media conglomerate Seven Network Ltd. Kerkorian also owns a controlling interest in hotel and gambling company, MGM Grand Inc.
